title: Gaspar is the best tour guide!!!
text: We had a wonderful experience. Our guide Gaspar was very knowledgeable as well as friendly while sharing so much interesting information. The hotel pickup was perfect. Gaspar’s knowledge of Barcelona and the Basilica were extensive. We had many tours on our vacation in southern Spain and Gaspar was the best guide we had. I would recommend him to anyone as well as use him again!!!

title: Wonderful City Tour
text: The tour was great!  We were able to see so much!  Our tour guide Joris was so knowledgeable and presented the information in such fun manner!  I would recommend him as your tour guide.
author: lindatP531TV

title: Unforgettable Barcelona Experience
text:
My family and I went on a tour with Alejandro during the strikes, and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience! He was incredibly knowledgeable and knew the best detours to ensure we could still see all the sights despite the disruptions.

He started the tour by asking what we wanted to see and where we wanted to go, which made the experience feel very personalized. Since my family had already taken a few tours in the days prior, Alejandro did a great job tailoring the itinerary to avoid repeating things we had already seen while making sure we didn’t miss anything important.

title: Amazing Tour
text: Joris is a terrific guide - friendly, knowledgeable and has a great itinerary.  He let me know his arrival time in advance and then outlined the sights we’d see.  At each stop, we walked about and found hidden treasures.  It was like a day spent with friends - comfortable and fun - but you learned tons about Barcelona.  The vehicle was clean, the site seeing was amazing and Joris was one of the best guides I’ve encountered.   Highly recommend.
author: Darlene_W
